title: 第15章 金发的辛西第16章 骑士与从者
slug: 骑士先生魔王真的不存在啊
lines: 第15章金发的辛西
“大自然的复仇！”
姆莉眼看着唐充满气势地大喊一声，随手变出那根十字形的木棍砸向了弓箭手。
弓箭手的反应很快，第一时间抬手挡下了砸向脑袋的木棍。可唐的速度也很快，这点时间已经足够他贴近弓箭手了。
抓取，反推……噗嗤一声，唐已抓着弓箭手的手腕用力顺着一个方向推去，用串着烤兔肉的尖木棍刺穿了弓箭手的下颌。
反应稍慢的另外一人直到现在还没反应过来发生了什么事情，但看到同伴转瞬即逝的模样，他还是被吓得本能做出了逃跑的动作。
而唐与他同步转身，顺手夺弓取箭张弓拉矢——
“伪·穿云箭！”
又是一道穿透声，这名男子的脑袋已经被箭射穿，然后一头扎在了地上。
连续击杀二人，唐再搭弓戒瞄向四周，转了一圈后箭矢指向了小心起身的姆莉，当场吓得姆莉高举双手。
唐轻轻放下弓箭而后收弓，这才松了口气。
“唐，你……呃，你比很多骑士还强呢。”姆莉有些尴尬地开口，其实她刚刚应该等唐解除戒备后再出来的。
“这是意志的力量，是梦想之力。”唐露出了微笑。
至于他口中的梦想与意志，也就是成为什么最伟大的骑士，这种力量来源姆莉是绝对不相信的，只当唐又在胡言乱语了。
“刚刚那是战技对吧？很标准的岩象战技呢，坚实而有力。”
“你说自然冲击和穿风刺吗？”唐微笑着，“我只是觉得这么喊很有气势，话说战技是什么？”
姆莉神情一怔，惊讶地看着唐。怪不得前后两次名称不一样，原来是瞎喊的吗？！
嘴角不自然抽搐的姆莉还是开口为唐解惑道：“战技……战技啊，就是结合了魔力与魔法的战斗技巧。”
“那我还不会。”唐很自然的接受了现状，最后蹲下身子，开始扒拉两具死尸的衣服。
“姆莉，来帮忙舔包。”唐说。
“啊？哦。”姆莉虽然不明白舔包是什么意思，但大抵能够看出唐是在做什么。
随后她小声念了一串魔法，吸引了唐的注意，然后对面前两具尸体释放了彩色的光华。
哗——两具尸体的装备全部解开锁扣，钱袋和其他小物件全部飞出，整齐地摆放在了地上。
“这是……摸尸魔法？”唐惊讶地看着姆莉。
“那是什么？就是一种日常用来整理东西的整理魔法，然后配合解缚魔法与解锁魔法一起使用。”姆莉感觉唐的话语有种贬义。
“记得我跟你说过的风象魔法吗？这三个都是。”姆莉补充道。
“也就是说，风象是偏功能性的，对吗？”唐用自己的方式做了复述概括。
“可以这么说。”
唐听完点头，看向姆莉的目光也多了诸多认可。
这时小黑也跑了过来，围着尸体转悠两下，然后抬头看向山上。
唐摸了摸小黑的狗头，吩咐道：“小黑，你先回去找骑士团，你就缠着曼波，他会明白的。”

Chapter 15 Blonde Cincy
"Nature's revenge!"
Muli watched as Tang yelled with great momentum, and then casually transformed the cross-shaped wooden stick and hit the archer.
The archer reacted quickly and immediately raised his hand to block the wooden stick hitting his head. But Tang was also very fast, and this time was enough for him to get close to the archer.
Grabbing, pushing back... With a pop, Tang Ji grabbed the archer's wrist and pushed hard in one direction, piercing the archer's jaw with a sharp wooden stick skewered with roasted rabbit meat.
The other person who was slower to react has not realized what happened until now, but when he saw the fleeting appearance of his companion, he was still frightened and instinctively made an escape action.
Tang turned around at the same time as him, grabbed the bow, took the arrow, opened the bow and drew the arrow——
"Fake cloud-piercing arrow!"
Phew——
There was another penetrating sound, and the man's head had been shot through by an arrow, and then he fell to the ground.
After killing two people in a row, Tang then took his bow ring and looked around. After turning in a circle, the arrow pointed at Muli who stood up carefully. Muli was so frightened that she raised her hands in the air.
Tang gently put down his bow and arrow, then retracted it, and then he breathed a sigh of relief.
"Don, you...well, you are stronger than many knights." Muli said awkwardly. In fact, she should have waited for Tang to get off guard before coming out.
"This is the power of will, the power of dreams." Tang smiled.
As for the dream and will he talked about, that is, to become the greatest knight, Mu Li absolutely did not believe in the source of this power, and just thought that Tang was talking nonsense again.
"That was a combat skill just now, right? It's a very standard rock elephant combat skill, solid and powerful."
"Are you talking about natural impact and wind piercing?" Tang smiled, "I just think it's very impressive to shout like this. What are the combat skills?"
Mu Li was stunned and looked at Tang in surprise. No wonder the names are different twice before and after. Was it just a random call? !
Muli, whose mouth twitched unnaturally, still opened her mouth to explain Tang's confusion: "Combat skills...combat skills are combat skills that combine magic and magic."
"Then I don't know how to do it." Tang accepted the situation naturally, and finally squatted down and started to pull the clothes of the two dead bodies.
"Muli, come and help lick the bag." Tang said.
"Huh? Oh." Although Mu Li didn't understand what licking the bag meant, she could probably tell what Tang was doing.
Then she whispered a string of magic to attract Tang's attention, and then released a colorful brilliance towards the two corpses in front of her.
Wow - all the equipment of the two corpses was unlocked, and all the money bags and other small items flew out and were neatly placed on the ground.
"Is this... corpse-touching magic?" Tang looked at Mli in surprise.
"What is that? It's a kind of organizing magic that is used daily to organize things, and then used together with unbinding magic and unlocking magic." Muli felt that Tang's words had a derogatory meaning.
"Remember the wind magic I told you about? It's all three." Mli added.
"In other words, the wind sign is more functional, right?" Tang summarized it in his own way.
"So to speak."
After hearing this, Tang nodded and looked at Muli with a lot of recognition.
At this time, Xiao Hei also ran over, walked around the body twice, and then looked up towards the mountain.
Tang touched Xiao Hei's dog head and ordered: "Xiao Hei, you go back to the Knights first, and then you pester Mambo, and he will understand."
